profile.headline: Solution Architect, Corporate AI at Tanium
profile.summary: I specialize in automation and CI/CD solutions at Tanium.

positions.title: Solution Architect, Corporate AI
positions.description: Skills: Project Management · Solution Architecture · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drive AI and platform capabilities in a DevOps role to enable developers and automate manual tasks. Spanning CI/CD, GitHub platform governance, and AI enablement with hands-on training, workshops, and on-boarding across the engineering org.

Core contributor to the GitHub Actions runner fleet with over 14 million job runs to date on ephemeral EKS nodes, ARM64, macOS (MacStadium), and Windows ARC runners across 6+ GitHub orgs

Led Windows ARC runner support on EKS including a hardened AMI pipeline and Windows Server 2022 image build on Oxide Computing infrastructure

Led MacStadium macOS runner integration into GitHub Actions, IaC for networking, service accounts, and runner registration enabling macOS CI for previously unsupported teams

Led end-to-end build of the enterprise AWS Bedrock AI platform: API Gateway + WAF, Lambda provisioner, DynamoDB usage tracking, KMS encryption, cross-region inference profiles

Designed and proposed to Leadership the enterprise AI governance framework, a  risk-based Policy with tiered approval workflows and data access classification

Delivered AI training workshops and led on-boarding sessions for engineering teams across the company as part of the AI enablement initiative

Designed and led development of the GitHub org-as-code platform, a Pulumi-based self-service for repos, teams, branch protections, secrets, and rulesets via PR-driven GitOps in order to meet FedRamp and auditing requirements

Architected and executed Terraform to Pulumi IaC migration for all GitHub organization configurations across 6 orgs

Delivered AL2 to Amazon Linux 2023 migration for EKS runner fleet and Artifactory infrastructure with zero CI/CD downtime

Resolved 600+ DevOps support tickets as primary escalation point for CI/CD platform issues across all engineering

positions.title: Software Developer - CI/CD
positions.description:
Created CircleCI CI/CD Pipelines to automatically create Github releases and automatically deploy helm charts to our K8s clusters. Reducing the total amount of time engineers spent manually doing those task by an average of 100 hours per month

Manage our CI/CD Pipelines and Infrastructure, and continually improve our testing capabilities through CI/CD

Developed a Python application and Grafana dashboard that collects and displays key performance metrics from Github, CircleCI, and Jira, storing that data in a Postgres database

Deployed a self-hosted github action runner to kubernetes via helm chart and created github action workflows that allow us to run in-depth testing on K8s components, reducing manual work needed from our engineers, and speeding up our deployment process.

Manage the day to day operations, and assist in the feature development of our Kubernetes clusters and operators running on AWS, GCP, and Azure, using Terraform, Go, and Helm

Integrated various SAST scanning tools into CI/CD pipelines in under a day for testing and evaluation purposes

Created a private CircleCI Orb to standardize our CI/CD functions and shared scripts

Built a CLI tool in python to mass manage Github Repository Settings, and modify common files like CODEOWNERS, stale.yml, and action workflow files

positions.title: Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
Create CI/CD pipelines to automate our deployments, upgrades, and general management of our Pivotal Cloud Foundry foundations and Pivotal Gemfire Clusters, reducing manual tasks by 75% in the last year by using concourse, python, bosh, chef, Jenkins, vault, and vSphere

Practice breaking and recovering components of our system with the team in workshops, 2 times a week, and develop automated recovery solutions for those scenarios

Led a department-wide 1-day sprint/hackathon to improve our customer engagement processes by utilizing automation and standardizing our documenting for top 10 common customer engagement scenarios

Identify up to 20 applications every week that are outside baseline performance, and consult with those teams to ensure they are compliant with standards, their apps are cloud-native, 12-factor, and setup for CI/CD

Fully automated a manual patching task that took the full team 48 hours to complete, and reduced that task to a single button push

positions.title: Senior Associate Programmer (Banking and Lending Platform DevOps)
positions.description:
Designed 5 KPI dashboards in Kibana and AppDynamics to monitor the performance of Discover's highly-critical core banking and lending platforms

Provided consultation for 4 different business units looking to adopt a DevOps culture and developed CI/CD pipelines for those teams

Advocated for the DevOps culture and mindset by presenting a 5-step process to senior management that highlighted 3 essential strategies for changing company culture

Managed 2 new projects by maintaining all project documentation, setting up team status meetings, and reviewing and setting timeboxed actionable items

positions.title: Associate Programmer (Regulatory Data Services)
positions.description:
Collaborated with business partners to translate quarterly Federal Reserve Board requirements into technical implementations for Fry14 Regulatory Reporting with an average 45-day cycle time from initial project conceptualization to final application, pre-venting fines of up to USD 500,000

Mentored 5 new hires, guiding them in the use of department tools and work processes

Spearheaded the creation, design, and implementation of a web-based tool with a 2-man team that centralized metadata, data governance, and data point mapping documentation; Enforced department standards and converted a manual 6-month validation task, to an instantaneous automated job, with a 7-day turnaround for feature enhancement requests

Campaigned for change in the department’s workflows, and trained over 20 teams in a new process that alleviated the use of a time-consuming manual task

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
Program and debug educational video games using Microsoft's Kinect SDK, the C# programming language, Microsoft's XNA framework, Unity3D, and web based technologies.
Involved in product life cycles from design to post release support. 
Managed and updated software on twenty five lab machines. 
Configured and maintained a lab server.

volunteerExperiences.description: Discover has a yearly event that gives BT Employees an opportunity to spend a day volunteering for a cause they support. During this event I built Bookcases for a local children's home.

projects.title: Interactive Media Window
projects.description: An interactive window in the Northern Illinois University Founders Memorial Library that allows the use of hand gestures to navigate news articles and RSS Feeds. The interactive window was created by integrating Microsoft Kinect technology, AngularJS, Unity3D, and projectors.

projects.title: Literacy in Motion, Bunnies in Space
projects.description: Literacy in Motion, Bunnies in Space is an educational video game created using the XNA game studio and the Kinect SDK. The purpose of the game is to help struggling readers in 4th and 5th grade learn tier two vocabulary words by playing through several mini-games using their body as a controller.
